paragraphs.body: Yahoo Sports reports that Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield made NFL history by not completing a single pass against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 8, a feat not seen since 1974. SB Nation and another Yahoo Sports article highlight that Mayfield was brutally honest about this performance, stating he does not care how the team won the game. In a press conference, Mayfield emphasized that 'whatever it takes' is required to win, regardless of the statistical anomaly. Sky Sports notes this rare occurrence occurred while the Buccaneers defeated the Falcons, marking one of the strangest games in NFL history.

headline: Baker Mayfield sets NFL record with zero completions as Buccaneers secure rare Week 8 victory over Falcons.
